title: Gap assessment v0
description: Decides, for one expected stage of one action, whether the stage happened. The central rule: a missing span is only 'confirmed_absent' when every way the telemetry itself could have lost it has been checked and ruled out, each with evidence. Anything less is 'unknown', 'not_instrumented' or 'telemetry_degraded' - never a program bug.

window.description: Interval searched: action start until stage deadline plus the exporter's maximum flush delay.

verdict.description: present: matching span(s) found. confirmed_absent: not found AND all checks passed - the event really did not happen. not_instrumented: nothing observes this layer/scope. telemetry_degraded: a probe/collector/ingest problem could explain the absence. unknown: not found, but at least one check could not be decided.

conclusive.description: Only 'present' and 'confirmed_absent' are conclusive. Analysis must not treat other verdicts as facts about the program.

template_confirmed.description: The chain template was confirmed by the user (an AI-proposed expectation can be wrong).

coverage_declared.description: A coverage declaration covers this layer, service and scope (route/message/table) for the whole window.

probe_alive.description: Heartbeats from the covering probe arrived for the whole window with no sequence gap.

sampled.description: This trace was sampled at this layer: always_on, or parent-based with a sampled parent, or a recorded sampling decision.

exporter_healthy.description: No export failures in the window, and a successful export after the window ended.

no_drops.description: spans_dropped = 0 and the queue never reached capacity in the window.

collector_healthy.description: Collector (if any) reported no drops/rejections in the window.

ingest_complete.description: Ingest watermark is past the window end: everything that arrived has been persisted.

context_propagated.description: The upstream stage is present and its span shows trace context was actually injected (cd.propagation.injected=true), and downstream reported no extract failures.

window_elapsed.description: Stage deadline plus maximum flush delay has passed; late spans are no longer expected.

clock_skew_bounded.description: Clock offset between the involved hosts is small relative to the window.

allOf.description: confirmed_absent requires every check to pass, and every telemetry-health check to cite evidence.

collector_healthy.description: not_applicable when probes export straight to Code Doctor ingest with no collector in between.

window_elapsed.description: Never not_applicable: late spans must no longer be expected.

clock_skew_bounded.description: not_applicable only with a note saying why (e.g. every involved span came from the same host clock).

allOf.description: telemetry_degraded must name at least one failed telemetry check.
